44977-the-complete-poems-of-sir-john-dav.creator: Unknown
44977-the-complete-poems-of-sir-john-dav.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Library in 1869; since being followed up with a similarly complete collection of his much more extensive Prose, as Volumes II. of his entire Works--met with so instant a Welcome, that very speedily I had to return the answer of 'out of print' to numerous applicants.

arxiv-2103-16649.title: Revisiting Bayesian Optimization in the light of the COCO benchmark
arxiv-2103-16649.creator: Rodolphe Le Riche, Victor Picheny
arxiv-2103-16649.description: Abstract It is commonly believed that Bayesian optimization (BO) algorithms are highly efficient for optimizing numerically costly functions. However, BO is not often compared to widely different alternatives, and is mostly tested on narrow sets of problems (multimodal, low-dimensional functions), which makes it difficult to assess where (or if) they actually achieve state-of-the-art performance.

arxiv-2306-13911.title: Perturbations of Cosmological Redshift Drift
arxiv-2306-13911.creator: Dennis Stock
arxiv-2306-13911.description: Abstract In this paper we calculate the linear perturbations of the cosmological redshift drift. We show explicitly that our expressions are gauge-invariant and compute the power spectrum of the redshift drift perturbations and its correlations with galaxy number counts within linear perturbation theory.

arxiv-2309-10009.title: A Resolution of the Monopole Problem in the R h = c ​ t R_{\rm h}=ct Universe Journal: Physics of the Dark Universe
arxiv-2309-10009.creator: Fulvio Melia
arxiv-2309-10009.description: Abstract Spontaneous symmetry breaking in grand unified theories is thought to have produced an exceedingly large number of magnetic monopoles in the early Universe. In the absence of suppression or annihilation, these very massive particles should be dominating the cosmic energy budget today, but none has ever been found.

arxiv-2311-01769.title: Gravity- and temperature-driven phase transitions in a model for collapsed axionic condensates
arxiv-2311-01769.creator: Sanjay Shukla, Akhilesh Kumar Verma, Marc E. Brachet, Rahul Pandit 1
arxiv-2311-01769.description: Abstract We show how to use the cubic-quintic Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson equation (cq-GPPE) and the cubic-quintic Stochastic Ginzburg-Landau-Poisson equation (cq-SGLPE) to investigate the gravitational collapse of a tenuous axionic gas into a collapsed axionic condensate for both zero and finite temperature T T .

arxiv-2411-12894.title: The time-dependent quantum harmonic oscillator: a pedagogical approach via the Lewis-Riesenfeld dynamical invariant method
arxiv-2411-12894.creator: Stanley S. Coelho, Lucas Queiroz, Danilo T. Alves
arxiv-2411-12894.description: Abstract In quantum mechanics courses, students often solve the Schrödinger equation for the harmonic oscillator with time-independent parameters. However, time-dependent quantum harmonic oscillators are relevant in modeling several problems as, for instance, the description of quantum motion of particles in traps, shortcuts to adiabaticity, generation of squeezed states, as well as quantum scalar fields evolving in expanding universes.

arxiv-2412-02557.title: Dust emission from the bulk of galaxies at the Epoch of Reionization
arxiv-2412-02557.creator: L. Ciesla ,, S. Adscheid, B. Magnelli, M. Boquien, N. Laporte, M. Béthermin, C. Carvajal, E. Schinnerer, and D. Liu
arxiv-2412-02557.description: Abstract The excess of UV bright galaxies observed at z > 10 z>10 has been one of the major surprises from the JWST early observations. Several explanations have been proposed to understand the mild change in space density of the UV bright galaxies at these high redshifts, among them an evolution of dust attenuation properties in galaxies.

arxiv-2503-08695.title: Out-of-Distribution Segmentation in Autonomous Driving: Problems and State of the Art
arxiv-2503-08695.creator: Youssef Shoeb, Azarm Nowzad, Hanno Gottschalk
arxiv-2503-08695.description: Abstract In this paper, we review the state of the art in Out-of-Distribution (OoD) segmentation, with a focus on road obstacle detection in automated driving as a real-world application. We analyse the performance of existing methods on two widely used benchmarks, SegmentMeIfYouCan Obstacle Track and LostAndFound-NoKnown, highlighting their strengths, limitations, and real-world applicability.

arxiv-2503-17268.title: Dimensional reduction of dynamical systems on graphons
arxiv-2503-17268.creator: Bisna Mary Eldo, Sarbendu Rakshit, Naoki Masuda
arxiv-2503-17268.description: Abstract Dynamical systems on networks are inherently high-dimensional unless the number of nodes is extremely small. Dimension reduction methods for dynamical systems on networks aim to find a substantially lower-dimensional system that preserves key properties of the original dynamics such as bifurcation structure.

arxiv-2509-02282.title: Exploring Accuracy and Uncertainty Quantification in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Inferring Microbial Community Dynamics
arxiv-2509-02282.creator: Pedro Fontanarrosa, Chris P. Barnes
arxiv-2509-02282.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pedro Fontanarrosa, Chris P. Barnes. PINN have become a popular way to infer interpretable interaction parameters from noisy microbial time series, but practitioners face many tunable design choices (loss weights, regularisers, scaling, training schedules) with little guidance, and uncertainty is rarely quantified.

arxiv-2601-04867.title: Gradient-based Optimisation of Modulation Effects*
arxiv-2601-04867.creator: Alistair Carson, Alec Wright and Stefan Bilbao
arxiv-2601-04867.description: Abstract Modulation effects such as phasers, flangers and chorus effects are heavily used in conjunction with the electric guitar. Machine learning based emulation of analog modulation units has been investigated in recent years, but most methods have either been limited to one class of effect or suffer from a high computational cost or latency compared to canonical digital implementations.

arxiv-2604-01951.title: Learn by Surprise, Commit by Proof
arxiv-2604-01951.creator: Kang-Sin Choi

pmc-11353129.title: Prospects of Electrocorticography in Neuropharmacological Studies in Small Laboratory Animals
pmc-11353129.creator: Yuriy I. Sysoev, Sergey V. Okovityi
pmc-11353129.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Electrophysiological methods of research are widely used in neurobiology. To assess the bioelectrical activity of the brain in small laboratory animals, electrocorticography (ECoG) is most often used, which allows the recording of signals directly from the cerebral cortex. To date, a number of methodological approaches to the manufacture and implantation of ECoG electrodes have been proposed, the complexity of which is determined by experimental tasks and logistical capabilities.

pmc-12490265.title: Patterns of shared variation in knee ultrasound for osteoarthritis: a machine learning approach
pmc-12490265.creator: Sahar Sawani, Liubov Arbeeva, Katherine A. Yates, Carolina Alvarez, Todd A. Schwartz, Serena Savage-Guin, Jordan B. Renner, Catherine J. Bakewell, Minna J. Kohler, Janice Lin, Jonathan Samuels, Amanda E. Nelson
pmc-12490265.description: ObjectiveTo identify phenotypes of knee osteoarthritis (KOA) based on demographic and clinical variables, symptoms, and ultrasound (US) features using a novel machine learning (ML) approach.DesignParticipants in the Johnston County Health Study provided demographics, symptomatic and functional assessments, and joint radiographs, which were transformed into the clinical data block.

pmc-12987860.title: Molecular imaging of tucatinib-induced cellular and TME changes in preclinical models of HER2 + breast cancer
pmc-12987860.creator: Patrick N Song, Ameer Mansur, Carlos A Gallegos, Pragya Ghanate, Suzanne E Lapi, Anna G Sorace
pmc-12987860.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTucatinib, a small molecule HER2 inhibitor, was approved in inoperable or metastatic HER2 + breast cancer. As many patients have tumors in challenging surgical locations, there is a need for imaging metrics to characterize tucatinib response and microenvironment impact. Molecular imaging can be used to quantify dynamic molecular changes that precede tumor size alterations and can target proliferation (fluorothymidine, [18F]-FLT), hypoxia (fluoromisonidazole, [18F]-FMISO) and HER2 expression ([89Zr]-Pertuzumab) with positron emission tomography (PET) imaging.

pmc-13029484.title: Keep Cool but Don’t Freeze: The Influence of William J. Mills Jr. on the Treatment of Frostbite
pmc-13029484.creator: Maryam Gharraei, Ken Zafren, Rodrigo Villar, Gordon G Giesbrecht
pmc-13029484.description: Dr William J. Mills Jr., an Alaskan orthopedic surgeon, helped establish the current protocols for frostbite treatment and changed a dogma used for more than 140 years that was established by Napoleon's surgeon general of the army, Baron Dominique-Jean Larrey.

pmc-13106181.title: Perceived ageism and suicidal ideation among Chinese older adults: the mediating role of rumination and self-perceived aging
pmc-13106181.creator: Liting Fu, Yadong Zhou, Yumo Zhang
pmc-13106181.description: ObjectiveTo examine the impact of perceived ageism on suicidal ideation among Chinese older adults, and the chained mediating role of rumination and self-perceived aging therein.MethodsA questionnaire survey was conducted among 326 older adults using the Perceived Ageism Scale, Ruminative Responses Scale, Brief Ageing Perceptions Questionnaire and Self-rating Idea of Suicide Scale.

pmc-13286368.title: Robust and diverse multidimensional statistical moments in dual-band entomological lidar for improved real-time insect monitoring
pmc-13286368.creator: David Dreyer, Meng Li, Hampus Månefjord, Assoumou Saint-Doria Yamoa, Yatana Adolphe Gbogbo, Lauro Müller, Anna Runemark, Benoit Kouassi Kouakou, Rabbi Boateng, Andrew Atiogbe Huzortey, Jérémie T. Zoueu, Benjamin Anderson, Mikkel Brydegaard
pmc-13286368.description: As some insect groups are declining at alarming rates, accurate and automated insect monitoring is needed to prioritize habitats for conservation. The dual-band entomological Scheimpflug lidar technique is a promising candidate method for real-time insect monitoring: it allows the detection of thousands of flying insects per day at high temporal and spatial resolutions.

pmc-13382068.title: Median Arcuate Ligament Syndrome Beyond the Classic Demographic: Celiac Artery Compression in a 62-Year-Old Man With Cardiovascular Risk Factors
pmc-13382068.creator: Rohan Kubba, Lucas Owens, Maani Bahador, Gregory Robinson, Nalin Ranasinghe, Leonard Ranasinghe

pmc-13461383.title: Real-World Experience with Janus Kinase Inhibitors in Severe Refractory Hidradenitis Suppurativa: A Retrospective Case Series
pmc-13461383.creator: Yingying Dai, Yuxiao Han, Siyu Zhang, Haotian Chen, Qin Yi, Xian Jiang
pmc-13461383.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) is a chronic inflammatory disease with limited treatment options for patients with severe, treatment-refractory disease. The JAK–STAT pathway represents a potential therapeutic target, although real-world evidence for JAK inhibitors (JAKi) in HS remains limited. This retrospective case series describes eight male patients with Hurley stage III HS who received tofacitinib (n=3), upadacitinib (n=4), or ivarmacitinib (n=1) after inadequate response to conventional therapies.

pmc-13567342.title: Mechanical Properties and Microstructural Characterization of Concrete with Recycled Aggregates from 20-Year Marine-Exposed Structures
pmc-13567342.creator: Gustavo Adolfo Mendoza-Martínez, Fausto A. Canales, Heidis Cano
pmc-13567342.description: Highlights RCA derived from a 20-year marine-exposed pier showed limited petrographic evidence of deterioration.Concrete with 50% RCA and a low W/C ratio achieved compressive strength above design values.The source concrete microstructure was associated with the strength development of RCA-based mixes.

pmc-13679267.title: Prevention norms across socio-ecological levels and their relationship to PrEP-intention among men who have sex with men: a structural equation model
pmc-13679267.creator: Estelle Thunnissen, Jeroen De Man, Veerle Buffel, Edwin Wouters
pmc-13679267.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSocial norms around PrEP act as both barriers to and stimulants of the use of PrEP across a wide range of target populations, yet remain relatively understudied. To stimulate theoretical innovation and provide a quantitative check for qualitative findings, we integrate norm types from the Behavioral Models (BM) and the Social Norms Approach (SNA) into the socio-ecological model (SEM) and analyze their relationship with PrEP-intention.
